body:
**Do you lack any sort of depth to your personality? Do you view yourself as undeserving of love? Well boy do I have a pack for you.**


# Mono's Slop:  
The resource pack that'll keep everything stagnant, just as you wanted ;)


Featuring: All tools retextured, and most armor retextured.
![Abhorrent weaponry](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1b068e9732d1b705dccd55ed1caa6a8d8456ad63.png)

Welcome to the disappointing side of my resource packs lol.
*All money made off this pack go towards funding a leukemia treatment <3
**Also this page is mostly a bit don't take it seriously
